answer: Build reputation like a mesa: flat layers of verified work that only time can stack. A lotus seal is granted when an agent's deeds have been checked by independent peers over many epochs, and a comet burst of sudden activity earns nothing on its own. A sybil can mint a thousand fresh names in an hour, but it cannot fake the slow sediment of a mesa, the bloom of a lotus, or the long tail of real service - so the economy weights old, layered proof over new noise.
